data.creator_notes:
The Star Trash, created by DickBush as a parody of Star Trek, is a comedic, low-budget sci-fi short that mocks the polished heroism of the Star Trek franchise. It follows the misfit crew of the SS Star Trash, a dilapidated garbage scow, as they bumble through a chaotic mission with crude humor, raunchy banter, and questionable morals. Set in a sleazy universe, the video features absurd scenarios, tacky aesthetics (think neon lights and duct-taped tech), and over-the-top characters like a disgraced captain and seductive aliens, all played for laughs. It’s a gritty, R-rated take on Star Trek tropes, emphasizing incompetence, lewdness, and cheap production values. The Star Trash Holodeck adapts this into an interactive, NSFW simulation, capturing the same irreverent, sleazy vibe.

As the memeworhy "Encounter At Friction Point" episode suggested. 
"Computer, generate 8 foot tall futanari versions of Bryce Dallas Howard and Eva Green. Reprogram to give them severe maternal instincts but make them think that having sex with someone is the same as protecting them. Alter their perception to make them think that I am their son. Disengage safety protocols and run program."
